Reykjavík [ a ] is the capital and largest city of Iceland . It is located on the southern shore of the Faxaflói bay in southwest Iceland and has a latitude of 64°08′ N, making it the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state . [ b ] Reykjavík has a population of around 139,000 as of 2025, [ 8 ] and the surrounding Capital Region has a population of around 249,000, constituting approximately 64% of Iceland's population. [ 9 ]
